body.sr: Nook je počeo od ostrva. Siros, u Kikladima. Kuće od kreča, mali barovi bez ukrasa. Ništa tamo nije novo. Ništa se ne pretvara da jeste.
body.en: Nook began on an island. Syros, in the Cyclades. Limewashed houses, small bars with bare walls. Nothing there is new. Nothing pretends to be.

body.sr: Nismo hteli grčki bar u Leskovcu. Uzeli smo ono što putuje: obične materijale, meru, i sobu u kojoj je razgovor glasniji od muzike.
body.en: We didn't want a Greek bar in Leskovac. We took what travels: plain materials, restraint, and a room where talk is louder than the music.

body.sr: Otvorili smo 19. juna, u ulici Koste Stamenkovića 23. Iza vrata koja se lako promaše.
body.en: We opened on 19 June, at Koste Stamenkovića 23. Behind a door that is easy to miss.
